intro: Meet the Rhino V1 Steel Manual Home Locker, the the perfect fusion of style and security. Crafting security with innovation and truct for many generations.

features.title: Tough Metal Build
features.text: Built for superior security, our compact home locker features a tough metal construction that offers unmatched strength and durability. Despite its small size, this sturdy locker provides a reliable and secure storage solution for your valuables, ensuring peace of mind.

features.title: Godrej Make Gordian Key Lock
features.text: Engineered for reliability, this robust dual-control Godrej 6 Lever Gordian Key Lock requires two unique keys for access, ensuring enhanced protection and control. Its smooth, intuitive mechanism makes locking and unlocking effortless while offering the highest standards of security.

features.title: Removable Shelf for Versatile Storage
features.text: Maximize your Home Locker’s storage potential with our removable shelf, designed for flexible organization. Easily adjust the space to accommodate taller items, creating a customizable and organized environment that keeps your valuables neatly stored and easily accessible.

features.title: Ultimate Security with 3 Way Solid Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: Our locker is equipped with 3-way solid steel shooting bolts for enhanced protection. These heavy-duty bolts reinforce the safe door, ensuring your valuables are secured with maximum strength.

features.title: Sleek and Ergonomic Handle
features.text: Designed for both style and ease, this modern handle enhances the locker’s aesthetics while offering superior functionality.

features.title: Mouting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Rhino V1 55 Litres Steel Manual Home Locker
